params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.table_name
params.description: Required. The unique name of the table from which to read. Values are of the form projects/<project>/instances/<instance>/tables/<table>.

params.name: data.app_profile_id
params.description: This value specifies routing for replication. If not specified, the "default" application profile will be used.

params.name: data.rows
params.description: The row keys and/or ranges to read. If not specified, reads from all rows.

params.name: data.filter
params.description: The filter to apply to the contents of the specified row(s). If unset, reads the entirety of each row.

params.name: data.rows_limit
params.description: The read will terminate after committing to N rows' worth of results. The default (zero) is to return all results.
